text: Git branching helps developers work on different tasks without affecting the main code. A common practice is to create a feature branch for each new feature or bug fix. This keeps your work separate from the stable version of the project. When your changes are ready, you can merge the branch back into the main branch. Many teams use pull requests before merging, so others can review the code first. This version control workflow makes teamwork safer and more organized, because everyone can see what changes are being made and why.
